outputs.justification: Public GitHub repository; page contains code and files (README, R scripts, mgen_proteins.txt) used by the authors and available for download.

This URL is an interactive web service for running AlphaFold predictions (server/web interface), not a static data repository page for the manuscript's deposited outputs. The authors state data derived from this server were deposited elsewhere (Zenodo DOIs).
DOI resolves to a Zenodo record (“M. genitalium AlphaFold3 Files”) that lists downloadable files (e.g., AF3_completed_zips.zip) and metadata; dataset files are available for download from the record.

Zenodo record page lists dataset files (pairs.tar, pools_2k.tar, pools_3k.tar, pools_4k.tar, pools_5k.tar, MD5SUM.txt) with download links and metadata; the record is accessible and files are downloadable.

STRING homepage and database are accessible and provide programmatic and web access to organism-specific interaction data; the manuscript cites downloading the STRING data for taxid:243273 on 2025-03-18.
